nativeAcceptance.launchMethod: Native CUA app launch; Finder left unchanged because another task was using it

limitations: Remembered credential item was not read for inspection; exact signed migration manifest and successful native reconnect were verified.
Same signing identity on this Mac; certificate expiry, locked keychain or identity changes are outside this acceptance.
repeatSteps: Export committed Native/GreenBubbles and staging script with git archive; copy installed main executable into staging source .build/release.
Build CLI with cargo build --release --locked; run synthetic metadata E2E.
Stage with existing certificate; verify main code unchanged, exact predecessor/successor CLI hashes, sticker digest, certificate and designated requirement.
Quit via native UI, confirm process absent, back up old bundle and install verified candidate.
Launch using native UI, open a conversation and refresh; repeat full quit and cold launch without entering credentials.
